family.description: This entry represents putative lysis proteins from Bacteriophage MS2 and Bacteriophage BZ13. The bacteriophage MS2 lysin protein swiss:C0M1L5 was identified as an overlapping cistron in the bacteriophage MS2 RNA [[cite:PUB00053761]]. This proteins induces the formation of specific membrane adhesion sites between the inner and outer membranes, apparently leading to host cell lysis. Lysis may be performed via activation of host murein hydrolases [[cite:PUB00097482],[cite:PUB00097483]].
family.name: Bacteriophage MS2, lysis protein
